items.summary: Ball's questionnaire says decisions should rest on a five-year outlook covering enrollment, staffing, salaries and other costs.
items.title: Base budget decisions on a five-year outlook

citations.quote: Strengthen City College’s long-term finances: Decisions should be based on a five-year outlook that carefully considers enrollment, staffing, salaries, and other costs…not just the next one or two years.
citations.locator: Your Goals: goals for your term

items.summary: Ball's questionnaire says he would track the 2024 Strategic Enrollment Management Plan's results in recruitment, retention, partnerships and completion.
items.title: Track results of the 2024 Strategic Enrollment Management Plan

citations.quote: Improve enrollment and student completions: I would track the results of the 2024 Strategic Enrollment Management Plan (SEMP) in recruitment, retention, partnerships, and completion.
citations.locator: Your Goals: goals for your term

items.summary: Ball's questionnaire says he would encourage exploring public-private partnerships for the Downtown Campus that could generate revenue and support students.
items.title: Explore public-private partnerships for the closed Downtown Campus

citations.quote: Create a new future for the Downtown Campus that closed this year: I would encourage the exploration of public - private partnerships that could generate revenue, support students, and reconnect the campus with the surrounding community.
citations.locator: Your Goals: goals for your term

items.summary: Ball's questionnaire says he would reform Board Policy 5.10 on Matriculation so annual counseling or education-plan reviews are standard for degree, certificate and transfer students.
items.title: Make annual counseling reviews standard under Board Policy 5.10

citations.quote: I would reform Board Policy 5.10 on Matriculation to make annual counseling or education-plan reviews standard for students pursuing a degree, certificate, or transfer.
citations.locator: Your Goals: policy you would like to reform
